text:
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked — pipeline `release/v1.13.0` failed in *verify-artifact* (artifact-verify)

jess: saw this, logs show 404 from cache-store on wheel index, then `artifact-checksum` mismatch :grimacing:

mahesh: hmm, shared-cache stamp looks different between runners, probably cache invalidation after midnight. trying manual restore from s3.

lina: can we just re-run verify-artifact job? `ci rerun job artifact-verify --build 4292` — low-risk and quick.

devops: FYI change window ends in 40m, if we can't get a green in two attempts we should roll back the canary promo and pin to `v1.12.9` for the release cut.

jess: canary wasn't promoted yet, the job failed during artifact verification before deploybot started canary. So rollback is to hold the release, not revert prod.

mahesh: manual restore failed first time, s3 path wasn't the one used by the runner. rehydrating the right key now. ETA ~6m.

ci-bot: Build 4292: artifact-verify FAILED

jess: also seeing a parallel test shard race in `analytics_test::test_batching` — it flakes locally when we run with `-n auto` and cache miss hits. Might be masking cause.

lina: if the test is flakey because of cache miss, that implies artifact was corrupted or partial. let's prioritize artifact integrity.

devops: agree. plan: 1) wait for manual restore (mahesh) 2) rerun artifact-verify 3) if still failing, pin release and re-run full pipeline in staging, notify release mgr. 

jess: I'm going to add a quick checksum assert to the artifact job to fail earlier with clearer message. pushing patch to CI job now.

mahesh: restore complete. re-running `ci rerun job artifact-verify --build 4292` now.

ci-bot: Re-run queued for job artifact-verify (build 4292)

(6m later)

ci-bot: Build 4292: artifact-verify PASSED

jess: nice. re-triggering the integration matrix: `ci start matrix release/v1.13.0`

ci-bot: Matrix started: 12 jobs

lina: watching. if any e2e fails, we have time to pin before change window closes.

(14m later)

ci-bot: Matrix job analytics-e2e failed — `analytics_test::test_batching` timeout on shard 3 :timeout:

mahesh: that looks flaky — increasing shard timeout might be bandaid. I'll re-run that job single-shard to see if it's deterministic.

devops: If rerun flakes, we should not block the cut indefinitely. Call: two reruns allowed. After second fail, pin to v1.12.9 and schedule a hotfix. Who owns hotfix?

jess: I'll own hotfix investigation and write up a short postmortem for release notes.

lina: Rerun 1 for analytics-e2e now.

ci-bot: analytics-e2e (rerun 1) PASSED

devops: great — proceed. remind release manager to delay announcement until we confirm all jobs.

jess: noted, updating release notes draft: removing the rollout bullet until tomorrow.

devops: closing loop: no rollback, no pin. keep an eye on the canary during early traffic. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
